title: declaration order
symptoms: The existing parser reports declaration_order at the recorded tool stage
possible_causes: A declaration is used before its visible declaration in the accepted language context
inspection_steps: Inspect the named declaration and its enclosing scope
repair_guidance: For a DUT-owned error, move the declaration before its use without changing scope or behavior
For trusted testbench or reference attribution, report compatibility blockage through existing policy
limitations: Knowledge does not authorize editing benchmark testbenches, expected outputs or reference RTL
